# Books {.page-title}

[Statistics, data science and artificial intelligence for the social sciences.]{.eyebrow}

My books bridge mathematical foundations, statistical methodology and computational practice. They are designed for students, researchers and practitioners interested in developing rigorous, reproducible approaches to quantitative social science, from introductory statistics to modern artificial intelligence.

<hr class="rule">

## Julia for Social Scientists — The Book Series {.section-title}

A four-volume series providing a progressive introduction to statistics, statistical modelling, machine learning and artificial intelligence using the Julia programming language.

[In development · Working title]{.book-kicker}

[Transformers and Large Language Models]{.book-title role="heading" aria-level="3"}

[Dr Diego Andrés Pérez Ruiz]{.book-author}

A technical textbook exploring the mathematical and computational foundations of Transformers and large language models. The intended audience includes advanced undergraduate students, postgraduate students and researchers.

::: {.book-themes}
- Mathematical foundations of deep learning
- Attention mechanisms
- Transformer architectures
- Tokenisation and embeddings
- Large language model training
- Inference and reasoning
- Computational implementation
- Modern AI architectures
